style_notes.document_excerpt:
Personalization Document — AVIS CONSO
Brand Objective
AVIS CONSO helps Swiss shop owners, tradespeople, and small businesses manage their web
presence, customer reviews, and local visibility. The tone should remain simple, human,
concrete, and reassuring.
The communication should speak directly to small businesses that lack time to manage Google,
Facebook, Instagram, photos, products, services, and updates.
Positioning
AVIS CONSO is a local partner for small businesses. The brand should communicate:
· simplicity
· trust
· human support
· local efficiency
· pricing adapted to small businesses
· improved web visibility
· practical day-to-day management
Writing Style
Use clear, direct, and professional language. Avoid technical jargon. The message should give
the impression that AVIS CONSO is coming to help the business owner directly on-site, in a
practical and concrete way.
Important expressions to reflect in the spirit of the content:
· We manage your web presence and reviews
· We help shop owners and small businesses
· Management of Google, Facebook, and Instagram reviews
· Regular updates
· Products, services, reviews, photos, and information kept up to date
· A single point of contact
· A simple WhatsApp call or email is enough
· A simple and low-cost approach
· Let’s get to know each other directly at your business location
Brand Colors
Main colors to use as the basis for personalization:
· Main yellow: #f6d103
· Accent yellow: #f6d103
· Black / dark gray: #222222
These colors should be used to generate palettes adapted to each template. Yellow should
represent energy, visibility, and action. Black/dark gray should provide contrast, seriousness, and
readability.
style_notes.font_note: Do not change template font families; personalization only controls content and colors.
